description: Taxonomy and ontology for title chain analysis of Massachusetts residential real estate

deed.description: Transfers ownership of real property from grantor to grantee

mortgage.description: Debt instrument secured by the property; creates a lien in favor of the lender

discharge.description: Releases a mortgage lien upon satisfaction of the underlying debt

municipal_lien.description: Certificate of Municipal Lien; documents outstanding municipal obligations such as taxes, water/sewer charges at a point in time
municipal_lien.note: Snapshot document; does not itself create or release a lien but evidences municipal claims at time of recording

homestead.description: Declaration of Homestead; protects a portion of home equity from unsecured creditor claims under Massachusetts law
homestead.note: Massachusetts allows one active homestead per owner; multiple declarations warrant review

notice.description: Formal recorded notification; may relate to foreclosure, default, pending action, or other legal matters

assignment.description: Transfers a mortgage from one lender to another; the lien remains open but the obligee changes
assignment.note: Does not release the mortgage; discharge must still come from the ultimate assignee

subordination.description: Agreement by which a lien holder agrees to take a lower priority position relative to another lien
subordination.note: Affects priority order of liens, not their existence

affidavit.description: Sworn statement recorded to clarify or establish a fact affecting title

power_of_attorney.description: Authorization for one party to act on behalf of another in real estate transactions

probate.description: Document related to transfer of property through an estate; may include executor deeds or court orders

release.description: Releases a non-mortgage lien or other encumbrance

reconveyance.description: Releases a deed of trust upon satisfaction of the underlying debt; equivalent to discharge for deeds of trust

open.description: Active and unresolved; creates an obligation or encumbrance that has not been satisfied or released

discharged.description: Explicitly released by a recorded discharge, reconveyance, or release document

assigned.description: Transferred to another party via assignment; still open but obligee has changed

superseded.description: Replaced by a subsequent document of the same type; no longer the controlling document

requires_review.description: App cannot determine state with sufficient confidence; human review recommended

party_roles.grantor: Party transferring an interest in property
party_roles.grantee: Party receiving an interest in property
party_roles.lender: Party providing financing; holds the mortgage lien
party_roles.borrower: Party receiving financing; subject to the mortgage lien
party_roles.mortgagee: Synonym for lender in mortgage context
party_roles.mortgagor: Synonym for borrower in mortgage context
party_roles.trustee: Party holding title as security in a deed of trust arrangement
party_roles.assignor: Party transferring a mortgage or lien to another
party_roles.assignee: Party receiving a transferred mortgage or lien
party_roles.municipality: Local government entity recording a lien or certificate

unreleased_mortgage.description: A mortgage exists with no corresponding discharge, reconveyance, or evidence of payoff
unreleased_mortgage.action: Obtain discharge or payoff documentation from lender

gap_in_chain.description: Break in grantor/grantee continuity; a deed grantor does not match the prior deed grantee

missing_discharge.description: A discharge references a mortgage that cannot be found in the document set
missing_discharge.action: Search for mortgage by book/page reference in discharge

unresolved_notice.description: A recorded notice has no corresponding resolution document
unresolved_notice.action: Investigate nature and current status of notice

assignment_without_discharge.description: A mortgage was assigned to another lender but no discharge from the assignee has been found
assignment_without_discharge.action: Obtain discharge from the assignee lender

duplicate_homestead.description: Multiple Declaration of Homestead documents recorded; only one is controlling
duplicate_homestead.action: Confirm which declaration is current and active

municipal_lien_at_closing.description: A Certificate of Municipal Lien recorded near time of sale may indicate outstanding obligations
municipal_lien_at_closing.action: Confirm all municipal charges were settled at closing

document_set_incomplete.description: Analysis may be incomplete; Massachusetts registries sometimes require name-based searches in addition to address-based searches to retrieve all recorded documents
document_set_incomplete.action: Verify document set completeness with both address and owner name searches

massachusetts_specific_notes.search_methods: Massachusetts registries of deeds require both address/parcel and owner name searches for complete results
massachusetts_specific_notes.homestead: Massachusetts General Laws Chapter 188 governs homestead declarations; protects up to $500,000 of equity
massachusetts_specific_notes.municipal_lien_certificate: Required at closing in Massachusetts to confirm no outstanding municipal charges
massachusetts_specific_notes.recording_reference: Documents are identified by Book and Page number; chronological order can be inferred from Book number
